history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young man with dark, messy hair is taking a mirror selfie in what appears to be a bathroom. He's wearing a navy blue varsity jacket with white sleeves and striped cuffs. A large, yellow letter "D" is prominently displayed on the left chest of the jacket, outlined in white. Underneath the jacket, he's wearing a black t-shirt with a graphic print. The mirror reflects a bright light source, possibly a flash from his phone, creating a lens flare effect and scattering light particles across the image. The background is a tiled wall, and a glimpse of a toilet can be seen to the right. The lighting is somewhat harsh due to the direct flash, but it illuminates the subject clearly. The overall mood is casual and youthful, with a hint of modern street style. The color palette is dominated by the navy blue and white of the jacket, contrasted with the yellow "D" and the neutral tones of the bathroom.
